import { request } from '@mpxjs/api-proxy'

export function fetchTrendingKeywords () {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    request({
      url: '/api/search/trending',
      success: ({ data }) => resolve(data),
      fail: reject
    })
  })
}

export function requestSuggestions (keyword, callbacks) {
  return request({
    url: '/api/search/suggest',
    data: { keyword },
    success: callbacks.success,
    fail: callbacks.fail
  })
}

item.text: 现有代码的问题是：趋势词使用了 Promise，但联想词仍是回调式；请求对象的 `abort()` 也无法统一覆盖 Web。改造会在服务层统一返回 Promise，并把 `AbortController.signal` 传给 API Proxy；页面层同时用控制器和递增请求序号，确保取消与旧响应防护都成立。

<script>
import mpx from '@mpxjs/core'

mpx.createApp({
  onLaunch () {
    console.log('shop launched')
  }
})
</script>

<script type="application/json">
{
  "pages": [
    "pages/search/index",
    "pages/product/detail"
  ]
}
</script>

---SEARCH---
<template>
  <view class="search-page">
    <input value="{{keyword}}" bindinput="onKeywordInput" placeholder="搜索商品" />
    <view wx:if="{{errorMessage}}" class="error-message">{{errorMessage}}</view>
    <view class="trending" wx:if="{{!keyword}}">
      <view wx:for="{{trendingKeywords}}" wx:key="*this" bindtap="chooseKeyword(item)">{{item}}</view>
    </view>
    <view class="suggestions">
      <view wx:for="{{suggestions}}" wx:key="id" bindtap="openProduct(item.id)">{{item.name}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import mpx, { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'
import { fetchTrendingKeywords, requestSuggestions } from '../../services/search'

createPage({
  data: {
    keyword: '',
    trendingKeywords: [],
    suggestions: [],
    errorMessage: ''
  },

  onLoad () {
    this._suggestionController = null
    this._searchVersion = 0
    this._unloaded = false
    this.loadTrendingKeywords()
  },

  async loadTrendingKeywords () {
    try {
      const trendingKeywords = await fetchTrendingKeywords()
      if (!this._unloaded) this.trendingKeywords = trendingKeywords
    } catch (error) {
      if (!this._unloaded && !this.isAbortError(error)) {
        this.errorMessage = '搜索失败'
      }
    }
  },

  onUnload () {
    this._unloaded = true
    this.cancelSuggestionRequest()
    this._searchVersion += 1
  },

  methods: {
    onKeywordInput (event) {
      this.search(event.detail.value.trim())
    },

    chooseKeyword (keyword) {
      this.search(keyword)
    },

    search (keyword) {
      this.keyword = keyword
      this.errorMessage = ''
      this.cancelSuggestionRequest()
      const version = ++this._searchVersion

      if (!keyword) {
        this.suggestions = []
        return
      }

      const controller = new AbortController()
      this._suggestionController = controller

      requestSuggestions(keyword, { signal: controller.signal })
        .then((suggestions) => {
          if (!this._unloaded && version === this._searchVersion) {
            this.suggestions = suggestions
          }
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          if (
            !this._unloaded &&
            version === this._searchVersion &&
            !this.isAbortError(error)
          ) {
            this.suggestions = []
            this.errorMessage = '搜索失败'
          }
        })
        .finally(() => {
          if (version === this._searchVersion) {
            this._suggestionController = null
          }
        })
    },

    cancelSuggestionRequest () {
      if (this._suggestionController) {
        this._suggestionController.abort()
        this._suggestionController = null
      }
    },

    isAbortError (error) {
      return Boolean(
        error &&
        (error.name === 'AbortError' ||
          (typeof error.errMsg === 'string' && /abort|cancel/i.test(error.errMsg)))
      )
    },

    openProduct (productId) {
      mpx.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/product/detail?id=${productId}` })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<style scoped>
.search-page { padding: 24rpx; }
.trending, .suggestions { margin-top: 24rpx; }
.error-message { margin-top: 16rpx; color: #d93025; }
</style>

---SERVICE---
import { request } from '@mpxjs/api-proxy'

export function fetchTrendingKeywords () {
  return request({
    url: '/api/search/trending'
  }).then(({ data }) => data)
}

export function requestSuggestions (keyword, { signal } = {}) {
  return request({
    url: '/api/search/suggest',
    data: { keyword },
    signal
  }).then(({ data }) => data.list)
}
